purpose: Source review for hypothetical benchmark sliders; research metadata only, not an executable profession rule or a compiled baseline update.
verificationLimits: Web pages were retrieved through the available web-search fallback after Firecrawl reported exhausted account credits.
Live-URL datamined tooltips were read; no current in-game client, recipe operation or full perk table was inspected.
Wowhead profession-trait IDs are reference identifiers. Their equality to saved C_Traits node IDs is unverified.
Guide and registry claims can differ in date and scope. No universal skill-to-yield, specialization-to-yield or stat-rating-to-percentage curve was established.

oreDiamondCaveat: Tooltips identify the matching ore and diamond capability; they do not supply a drop probability. Simulating an unlocked node does not establish an unconditional expected diamond rate or authorize transferring another ore's rate.

statApplicability.conflict: research/v3/mechanics.md M11 calls prospecting Multicraft likely, and Wowhead's guide lists broad profession stats. Current wow-professions text explicitly excludes Prospecting and Crushing; do not enable an automatic Multicraft multiplier from the older note.

safeSimulationContract: A neutral manual output factor can change an explicitly hypothetical estimate without claiming to represent measured skill or specialization bonuses.
Label manual factors as assumptions relative to the selected research estimate; avoid calling that estimate an unskilled baseline or applying the same existing specialization bonus twice.
Skill and node-rank sliders describe target context. Apply numeric yield conversion only through a compatible recipe, expansion, build and output-specific model.
Keep measured sample counts and confidence unchanged. Simulation must not create evidence or replace the recorded character's actual profile.
Resourcefulness savings change expected input consumption or cost, not expected output units per completed operation.

If exposing independent Resourcefulness proc chance p and saved fraction s as manual assumptions, expected input consumption is nominal batch times (1 - p*s). A default 30% saving is an unverified approximation, not a verified general mechanic.
Do not derive occurrence probability, conditional ranges or quality-rank redistribution from a generic expected-output multiplier.
Do not convert locked or unknown conditional outputs into a numeric rate merely because the simulation control is enabled.
historicalNote: MIDNIGHT_MODEL_README.txt describes addon 0.9.67's manual low/high interpolation and manually gated diamonds.
